column3: “It was complete” is rendered “was finished.” “The holy things of David” is rendered “the things that David … had dedicated,” and “articles” as “utensils.”
“The articles of holiness” is rendered “the holy utensils”; “the priests the Levites” is rendered “the Levitical priests.”
“From multitude” is rendered with “so many … that.”
“The innermost room” is rendered “the inner sanctuary.”
NASB supplies “their” and renders “covered” as “made a covering.”
NASB supplies “of the ark”; “the heads of the poles” is rendered “the ends of the poles.” The Hebrew “it was there” is rendered “they are there.”
“Only” is rendered “nothing … except”; NASB supplies “there” and “a covenant.”
“Who were found” is rendered “who were present,” and “not to keep to divisions” as “without regard to divisions.” NASB uses parentheses.
“The Levites the singers” is rendered “the Levitical singers,” and “relatives” as “kinsmen.” The two stringed instruments are reversed. “Blowing a trumpet on trumpets” is rendered “blowing trumpets.”
“It belonged as one” is rendered “in unison.” NASB supplies “saying” and “indeed,” and “instruments of the song” is rendered “instruments of music.”
